findings.title: Recorded PLC outputs: D1 commanded for item 201 in Auto, later Faulted 23
findings.inference: In preserved plc.output evidence, an earlier sample shows Auto (Mode=1) with D1_ExtendCmd=true for ActiveItemId=201 RequestedRoute=1, and later samples show Faulted (Mode=3, FaultCode=23, FaultText D1 extend feedback timeout) with Motor_RunCmd and D1_ExtendCmd false and StackLight_Red=true. This is a recorded-state observation only, not a new live test or a pass/fail verdict on R-13 timing.
assumptions: Evidence is recorded-not-live with output quality unknown in the original evidence.
No injected-truth ref is cited; world.raw_image and plc.acknowledged records are not used as plc.output claims.
findings.uncertainty: Sampling gaps between preserved windows, unknown numeric disposition/route code definitions beyond the PLC-provided text fields, and no HMI evidence prevent a live requirement verdict or timing measurement.

findings.title: Recorded PLC outputs: Auto/ReleaseReady and changing exit/runout counts
findings.inference: Preserved plc.output samples show Auto with Motor_RunCmd=true, a later ReleaseReady=true sample, CountRunout changing from 0 at sequence 1203 to 1 at 1219 with CompletionExit=3, and by sequence 2401 recorded counts CountExitA=1, CountExitB=1, CountRunout=3, CountMisroute=1. These are recorded counter/completion values only; they do not by themselves prove individual A/B/runout requirement passes.
assumptions: Evidence is recorded-not-live with output quality unknown in the original evidence.
